results.title: Return of the Skate
results.overview: Fish-like aliens crash-land on Earth, trapped in a granny's jar—until a band's visit sparks a bizarre, smell-off war.

results.title: Wrath of Thorn
results.overview: The fate of Thorn and his bloodline are finally revealed as the final battle for the soul of Avondale threatens to destroy not just the small town, but the world beyond.

results.title: The Scripted Muppet Caper
results.overview: When most people think of the Muppets, they think of the colorful characters made out of fleece and foam. But as with every movie, it all starts on the written page. Before returning to the big screen, the Muppets returned to the writers’ room. Muppets head writer JERRY JUHL was joined this time by TOM PRATCHETT, JACK ROSE, and JAY TARSES to take the gang overseas to jolly old England, in JIM HENSON’S directorial debut. With music by JOE RAPOSO, THE GREAT MUPPET CAPER is a true delight!

results.title: Remember To Enjoy The Light Before It’s Gone
results.original_title: Remember To Enjoy The Light Before It’s Gone
results.overview: In this reflective short film, the Weeknd speaks to his younger self, encouraging him to ask questions about the future and remember the light before it's all gone.

results.original_title: Duran Duran - Live at Baloise Session 2025
results.overview: Duran Duran, pop pioneers who became global icons, have never stopped looking to the future while embracing their heritage. In the cosy intimacy of the Baloise Session, the band gets closer to the audience. An authentic concert without artifice.

results.title: Drug Lord's Redemption
results.overview: A former successful drug baron lives a life of debauchery until he is sentenced to a long prison term. In prison he becomes a Christian and leads a prison revival.

results.title: Teething Problems
results.overview: Babysitter Cassie gets more than she bargained for when the baby becomes a little terror.

results.title: The Two of Us
results.overview: Devastated by the murder of his daughter Elle on Christmas Eve, Tim Edwards finds solace and embarks on a transformative quest for healing and self-discovery.

results.title: A Lover's Vow
results.overview: In the thrilling conclusion to Brenda Jackson’s The Grangers series, Dalton Granger’s life is in danger, and private investigator Jules Bradford is the only one who can protect him. As they fight to uncover the truth, their partnership turns personal, and Dalton is determined to prove he’s a man worth risking it all for. With love and legacy on the line, will they find their future together?

results.title: Dilli Dark
results.overview: Michael Okeke, a Nigerian living in New Delhi wants to get his MBA and settle in India. But his part-time job as a drug dealer will jeopardize his plans, not to mention the open racism he is facing.

results.title: Sins of My Husband
results.overview: Tony Dandridge is caught and exposed as a serial killer and is killed by the police. His wife Katherine claims that she knew nothing about her husband’s horrors, but the community and the press don’t believe it and torment her. Her very unlikely supporter is Doreen, the mother of the only victim of Dandridge’s to survive. It becomes a cat and mouse game as it appears possible that Katherine or Doreen may be lying or is it both of them?

results.title: A Letter From October
results.overview: By the time of Halloween, Dead wakes up from their sleep. But one too scared to go, Try to send letters from afar. It's been years, but not one has been sent by now.

results.title: Parallel of Dreams

results.title: The Fable
results.overview: In the late 1980s in the Himalayas, a man's life is turned upside down by a series of mysterious fires destroying his fruit orchards. As he struggles to stop the outbreaks, the escalating mystery forces him to confront not only the truth behind the blazes but also the long-hidden secrets of his family and his own past.

results.title: Jesse Welles: With the Devil

results.title: LIVE at the Court
results.overview: Three basketball players step onto the court, each with a rhythm of their own. As their movements are studied and reimagined, their game is then recontextualized into jazz, revealing the artistry within sport and the music hidden in motion.

results.title: Ambalamukkile Visheshangal
